reason: Claim c1 (in_scope, tolerance/route-drop failure) was rebutted by runtime probes on the real kernel: t7 (21/25 valid cases within tolerance) and t10 (44/51 cases, worst absolute error 1.06e-6, four orders of magnitude inside the contract tolerance 0.01+0.0002|target|, finite FP32 [M,N] output, correct dtype/shape). The 11 reported failures across both probes were traced to my own probe-generated malformed inputs (wrong weight shape [M,1], row sums > 1) which validate_inputs correctly rejected — not kernel defects. Legal edge cases the contract explicitly admits all passed: expert receiving zero routes, all tokens sharing one expert pair, Q=1 all-to-one-expert, all-zero routing rows, extreme ±0.5 FP16 values, shapes from 1x1x1 to 129x129x129 with E up to 8 and Q up to 4, skewed routing. No route dropping, duplication, or out-of-tolerance output was observed on any contract-admitted input.
